Subject: Mutual Action Plan + EB meeting cadence to finalize close — Nimbus Health

Lydia — great to meet last week. Per our call I pulled together a compact mutual action plan that maps evaluation milestones to executive briefings and procurement gating. The goal: lock the EB cadence and get final signatures before the end of Q3.

High level asks:
- Confirm exec sponsor(s) who will attend two 45-min EB check-ins (tech review + business KPIs).
- Provide windows for guest execs (CEO/CTO) across Aug 24–28.
- Procurement: confirm any remaining evidence needs (SOC 2 artifacts, retention SLAs).

I attached Nimbus_MAP_v3.xlsx and added a short availability grid (columns = exec, preferred times). Please review and suggest 2 preferred EB slots. We want to run the first EB as a technical deep-dive and the follow-up as a commercial/SLI review.

Link to MAP: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2bMAPv3/view

Next steps: if you can confirm sponsors + two slots by EOD Friday (Aug 21), we’ll lock calendar invites and route the final contract for signature.

Thanks — Jordan

Jordan — thanks, this looks useful. Quick answers:
- Exec sponsor: our VP of Product, Tom Park, will own the EB for the technical session; CEO Lydia Chen will attend the business KPIs/contract session if timing permits.
- Preferred slots: Aug 25 morning (10:00–11:00 PT) and Aug 27 afternoon (14:00–15:00 PT). We have a board prep window on Aug 26 so want to avoid that.
- Procurement: we still need clarifications on data residency controls and a short SOC 2 evidence pack (system description + recent bridge letter). Procurement copied here will confirm by EOD.

I reviewed Nimbus_MAP_v3.xlsx briefly; can you add a 1-line owner for each MAP row so we can tell who at Redwood is responsible? That will help our stakeholders.
